## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who is the user and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed solution

What should happen? A rough sketch is fine.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you ruled out and why.

## Affected areas

- [ ] Backend (`backend/`)
- [ ] Frontend (`frontend/`)
- [ ] Data layer / providers
- [ ] Strategies / risk math
- [ ] i18n / content
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Additional context

Mockups, links, prior art, related issues.
